==English==
{{wikidata lexeme|L222623}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|smuckle||dialectal}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:from|smuckle<ety:bor<nl:smokkelen<unc>><nds:smuggeln<unc>>>|tree=1}}
From earlier {{m|en|smuckle}}, either from {{bor|en|nl|smokkelen||to smuggle}}, a frequentative form of {{der|en|dum|*smugen|smūken|to act secretly, be sneaky}}, from {{der|en|odt|*smugan}}, or from {{bor|en|nds-nl|-}} or {{bor|en|nds-de|smuggeln}}; all are from {{der|en|gmw-pro|*smeugan|t=to creep; slip through or into}}.

{{col-top|2|cognates and related terms}}
Cognate with {{cog|stq|smuggelje|t=to smuggle}}, {{cog|fy|smokkelje|t=to smuggle}}, {{cog|nds-de|smuggeln}}, {{m|nds-de|smuckeln|t=to move insidiously, smuggle}}, {{cog|de|schmuggeln|t=to smuggle}}, {{cog|da|smugle||to smuggle}}, {{cog|sv|smuggla||to smuggle}}. Related also to {{cog|is|smjúga||to creep, penetrate}}, {{cog|sv|smyga||to sneak, slip, crawl, lurk, steal}}, {{cog|de|schmiegen|t=to nestle, wrap, snuggle}}, {{cog|ang|smēogan}}, {{m|ang|smūgan|t=to creep, crawl, move gradually, penetrate}}.
{{col-bottom}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsmʌɡəl/}}
* {{audio|en|En-au-smuggle.ogg|a=AU}}
* {{rhymes|en|ʌɡəl|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{wp}}
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|intransitive}} To [[import]] or [[export]], [[illicitly]] or by [[stealth]], without [[paying]] [[lawful]] [[customs]] [[charge]]s or [[duties]].
#: {{syn|en|run}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To bring in [[surreptitiously]].
# {{lb|en|transitive|obsolete}} To [[fondle]] or [[cuddle]]. <!-- alt form of snuggle? -->
# {{lb|en|slang}} To thrash or be thrashed by a bear's claws, or to swipe at or be swiped at by a person's arms in a bearlike manner.
